Register IPN URL.description: Registers the URL Pesapal notifies when a payment status changes.

Submit Payment Order.description: Creates a payment order and returns a redirect URL for the payer.

Request Refund.description: Requests a full or partial refund of a completed payment.

Cancel Pending Order.description: Cancels an order that has not been paid yet.

Get Transaction Status.description: Checks whether a payment has completed, e.g. after an IPN arrives.

List IPN URLs.description: Lists the IPN URLs registered for this merchant account.
List IPN URLs.code:
// List registered IPN URLs (to find an ipn_id).
get('URLSetup/GetIpnList');
